ramp_down_gated.case: script A's reproduction arm, float64, dt 0.5 ms, protocol Ramp: the field held at 100 Hz for 3 s from rest (unlocked), then down at 0.25 Hz/s towards 5 Hz; PhaseLag's spin recorded every step; the windowed ratio of the spin over 2 pi times the commanded frequency over 0.2 s windows, the first window centred after the hold with the ratio at least 0.99, read at the commanded frequency at its centre
ramp_down_gated.prediction: 31.73 Hz, within 0.03 Hz (the design measurement's stated resolution, the rate times half the window); the last unlocked window near 31.56 Hz (reported)
ramp_down_gated.why: the ramp's value over each step is its mean over the step (half a step earlier than the measurement's end-of-step sample, 6e-5 Hz at this rate) and the field turns by its exact integral; both differ from the measurement's by far less than the resolution, but the body rocks for 270 s before it relocks and nearby trajectories separate there, so the figure may move within the band where the measurement saw the body lock and unlock intermittently (31.73 to 31.56 Hz)
ramp_down_gated.if_it_differs: stop and report; no criterion is adjusted

gate_6_ramp_phase.case: a sphere's field through the front door, the integrating field 0.2.0 driven by drives.Ramp from f0 by k per second, dt 1 ms, 1000 steps; the field's angle read from the recorded flux density at every step

gate_6_ramp_phase.guard: 0.1.0 refuses the ramp on its frequency and a controller writing it (command.held-constant), naming 0.2.0; it accepts a constant drive

gate_7_phase_lag.prediction: PhaseLag's mean lag over the window equals arcsin(2 pi f R / (m B)) within tan(0.5) x 4e-4 = 2.2e-4 rad on the MRS rung (its stated discretisation, 4e-4 relative in the resistance), and within 1e-9 rad against the constant resistance
gate_7_phase_lag.omega_dt: 2 pi x 10 Hz x 0.5 ms = 0.0314 rad, 143 times the MRS tolerance and 3e7 times the constant resistance's
